Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent concluded with the NCBI assembly page as the “link to the files,” failing to meet the task’s time-specific requirement (May 2020) and to identify the canonical file repository. It did not verify or provide the Broad Institute FTP directory for CanFam3.1 (ftp://ftp.broadinstitute.org/distribution/assemblies/mammals/dog/canFam3.1/), which was the relevant files location, leading to the wrong final answer and premature termination.
